subject: Nexus Health: Onboarding roadmap, pre-kickoff checklist & CS owners
content:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@nexushealth.com>, Elena Brooks <elena.brooks@nexushealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nexus Health: Onboarding roadmap, pre-kickoff checklist & CS owners

Team / Samir & Elena —

Quick handoff: Nexus Health signed the agreement (annual commitment, $420k ARR, starts billing 4/1). They plan a phased rollout across two product lines: Clinical Insights (priority) followed by Provider Assist. High-level commitments below and immediate asks.

Why this matters
- Customer has a strict SOC2 + patient data processing checklist; they will require VPC peering and a private ingest lane (no S3 public ingestion).
- Expected peak QPS: ~120 r/s for Clinical Insights during pilot; steady-state ~25 r/s.
- Go-live target for pilot: 2028-05-15 (soft launch), full launch target 2028-07-01.

Key artifacts attached (please review before kickoff):
- Nexus_SOW_v1.pdf — draft SOW with acceptance criteria and success metrics
- nexus_network_diagram.png — proposed network topology (includes VPC/subnet info)
- Nexus_Signed_Contract_20280315.pdf — signed contract via DocuSign

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Confirm CS lead and primary technical owner for the activation.
2) Prioritize SOC2 evidence checklist and schedule a 45-min security sync with Nexus security (Samir) next week.
3) Validate the SOW acceptance criteria and flag any timing conflicts with platform capacity (dedicated nodes & DB retention policy).
4) Draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for pilot and full launch — target to share MAP with Nexus by 2028-03-30.

Suggested owners (sales recommends):
- CS lead (post-sale orchestration): Marissa Cole
- Technical delivery lead (networking, VPC peering): Karthik Iyer
- Acceptance & success metrics owner: Tessa Morgan

Samir / Elena — thanks for the partnership. If these owners look good we’ll schedule a 60-min kickoff (internal prep + customer kickoff) for week of 3/27. Please share any hard constraints (compliance windows, blackout dates, internal approvers).

Next steps
- Internal confirmation of owners (Marissa/Karthik/Tessa) — please reply-all by EOD 3/23.
- Security sync scheduling: Samir, what times work 3/27–3/29?
- I’ll upload the MAP draft to the Drive link above once owners confirmed.

Thanks —
Priyom

Subject: Re: Nexus Health: Onboarding roadmap, pre-kickoff checklist & CS owners

Thanks Priyom — I can take the CS lead.
Quick notes after a skim of attachments:
- SOW: acceptance criteria looks standard but need to update the rollback/rollback windows section to include a 2-hour rollback SLA for pilot.
- Network diagram: Karthik, we’ll need a clearer diagram for ingress IPs (Nexus wants static egress addresses).
- Timeline: tight for a 5/15 soft launch if SOC2 evidence and VPC peering take longer than a week.

I’ll block time for an internal prep sync 3/26 and can be on the customer kickoff the week of 3/27.

Marissa

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@nexushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nexus Health: Onboarding roadmap, pre-kickoff checklist & CS owners

Assigning technical delivery responsibilities:
- I’ll own the VPC peering and networking tasks. Can someone from Nexus confirm the VPC id, CIDR, and whether they prefer cross-account peering or a Transit Gateway? Samir, you mentioned Cloud team will provide details.
- I’ll also coordinate the initial load testing plan for the pilot and confirm whether we should use Dedicated nodes or Redwood Hosted for the pilot (cost/latency trade-offs).

Potential risks I see:
- Compliance evidence: Nexus requires retention logs for 13 months; our default retention for debug logs is 90 days — need signoff from Platform on extended retention.
- IP stability: Nexus needs static egress. If we can’t guarantee static egress on Hosted plan, we should recommend Dedicated for pilot.

I’ll draft a technical checklist and share in the Drive folder by 3/25.

-Karthik

Action items before kickoff:
- Nexus: share VPC id, CIDR, and list of required approvers for production access (Samir) — due 3/27 EOB.
- CS: Marissa to update SOW rollback window + MAP draft (internal review by 3/28).
- Eng/Platform: Karthik to confirm retention options and recommended compute (Dedicated vs Hosted) by 3/28.

If anyone needs to reassign owners, flag now — otherwise we’ll proceed with the team above.

Priyom
